## New skill

- **Skill name:** `skill-name` (must match the folder and `name:` frontmatter)

### Checklist

- [ ] Folder is `tableau-studio-skills/tableau-agent/<category>/<skill-name>/` (or `tableau-mcp-skills/<harness>/<skill-name>/`) and `name` matches the folder.
- [ ] Skill is listed under that category in `scripts/categories.ts`.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter has `name` and `description`.
- [ ] Heavy detail lives in `references/`, not in `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Optional README is accurate; the site uses it as the details page.
- [ ] `npm run validate && npm run build` pass locally (from `site/`).
